# Gagan Shukla — Freelance Full Stack Developer (Apps, Websites, SaaS, CRM, HRMS, Bid Management)

> Gagan Shukla is a full-stack software engineer based in Noida, India. He builds Android/iOS apps (Flutter, React Native), websites and web apps (Next.js, React), and business software (CRM, ERP, HRMS, e-commerce, SaaS) for clients in India and worldwide. 4+ years of development experience, 5+ production apps shipped. Primarily available for freelance projects (fixed-scope, retainer or dedicated developer) for clients in India and worldwide.
